description: This file contains SCSS mixins for image styling, including responsive images (`img-fluid`) and retina images (`img-retina`). The mixins handle scaling and high-DPI display support.

methods.name: img-fluid
methods.description: Mixin for making images responsive by setting max-width to 100% and height to auto.

methods.name: img-retina
methods.description: Mixin for setting background images suitable for retina displays, with support for high-resolution backgrounds and sizes.
